I am very disappointed with this experience. I took my two dogs to this groomer for a service, and unfortunately, they both suffered from razor burn in their genital area.

I had specifically asked her not to shave that area, as they had already experienced the exact same problem during a previous grooming session with her. Despite this precaution and my recommendations, I find myself having to consult the veterinarian again for the same reason.

I can understand that an incident can happen once, but for the same situation to recur when the problem was known and I had clearly asked her to avoid that area is, in my opinion, a real failure to follow the client's instructions.

What disappoints me even more is the groomer's response: "It's nobody's fault, your dogs are just more sensitive." I can certainly understand that some dogs have more sensitive skin than others. However, it was precisely because my dogs had already reacted this way after a previous grooming session that I took the precaution of explicitly requesting that their private parts not be shaved. I would have appreciated it if this information had been taken into account rather than having to deal with the same consequences a second time. Furthermore, the cost of the service increased from €55 to €60.

I want to emphasize that my two dogs look very handsome after their grooming. I would have been completely satisfied if the rest of their bodies had been groomed with the same care, while still respecting my request regarding their private parts.

While I left with dogs that looked well-groomed, I also left with two dogs suffering from significant skin irritations and requiring another visit to the vet. What should have been a moment of care and well-being for them turned into discomfort, worry, and veterinary expenses that, in my opinion, could have been avoided.

A problem can happen once, but when the same situation recurs despite clear instructions given after the first incident, it seems legitimate to question whether the specific needs of the animals were being taken into account. This is all the more regrettable as I would have been delighted with the service if this simple precaution had been respected.

A beautiful aesthetic result should never come at the expense of the animals' well-being.
Excellent cat grooming, with genuine kindness, explanations, and advice. I highly recommend it.
